_note: Dates are main days in IST. Lunar dates vary by region and panchang; 'approx' ones (moon sighting, regional tithi) show as 'around'. Checked against several published 2026-27 calendars in Oct 2026. Add next year's dates before Dec 2027.

festivals.name: Diwali
festivals.story: The festival of lights: diyas on every ledge, rangoli at every door.

festivals.name: Bhai Dooj
festivals.story: Tilak, sweets and gifts between brothers and sisters, just after Diwali.

festivals.name: Chhath Puja
festivals.story: Prayers to the setting and the rising sun, at rivers and ghats.

festivals.name: Guru Nanak Jayanti
festivals.story: The birth of Guru Nanak Dev Ji, with prabhat pheris and langar for all.

festivals.name: Christmas
festivals.story: Stars, plum cake and carols, from Goa to Kohima.

festivals.name: New Year
festivals.story: A fresh kolam at the door for a fresh year.

festivals.name: Lohri
festivals.story: Bonfires, peanuts and rewri in Punjab as winter turns.

festivals.name: Pongal & Sankranti
festivals.story: Harvest time: kites over Gujarat, pongal boiling over in Tamil Nadu, ellu-bella in Karnataka.

festivals.name: Republic Day
festivals.story: The Constitution of India came into force on 26 January 1950.

festivals.name: Maha Shivaratri
festivals.story: A night of fasting, prayer and staying awake for Shiva.

festivals.name: Eid ul-Fitr
festivals.story: The end of Ramadan, with sheer khurma, new clothes and mehendi.

festivals.name: Holi
festivals.story: Colours, gujiya and one rule: bura na mano, Holi hai!

festivals.name: Ugadi & Gudi Padwa
festivals.story: New year in the Deccan, with bevu-bella: bitter and sweet, together.

festivals.name: Baisakhi, Vishu & Puthandu
festivals.story: The harvest new year, from Punjab to Kerala to Tamil Nadu.

festivals.name: Ram Navami
festivals.story: The birth of Lord Rama, with bhajans and panakam.

festivals.name: Eid al-Adha
festivals.story: A festival of sacrifice and of sharing with neighbours.

festivals.name: Independence Day
festivals.story: Kites, tricolours and patriotic songs on every street.

festivals.name: Raksha Bandhan
festivals.story: A rakhi tied, a promise made.

festivals.name: Janmashtami
festivals.story: Krishna's birthday at midnight, with little footprints drawn at the door.

festivals.name: Ganesh Chaturthi
festivals.story: Ganpati comes home with modaks, music and ten days of celebration.

festivals.name: Onam
festivals.story: Kerala's harvest festival: pookalam flower carpets, sadya and boat races.

festivals.name: Navratri & Durga Puja
festivals.story: Nine nights of garba, dandiya, golu dolls and pandal hopping.

festivals.name: Dussehra
festivals.story: Good wins over evil, and Mysuru's Dasara lights up.

festivals.name: Diwali
festivals.story: The festival of lights: diyas on every ledge, rangoli at every door.

festivals.name: Christmas
festivals.story: Stars, plum cake and carols, from Goa to Kohima.

anyday.name: Just because
anyday.story: No festival needed to light a diya for someone.

messages.en: Wishing you light, laughter and lots of mithai.
messages.hi: आपको रोशनी, हँसी और ढेर सारी मिठाई की शुभकामनाएँ।
messages.kn: ನಿಮಗೆ ಬೆಳಕು, ನಗು ಮತ್ತು ಸಿಹಿ ತುಂಬಿರಲಿ.

messages.en: May the year ahead be bright and full of colour.
messages.hi: आने वाला साल रोशन और रंगों से भरा हो।
messages.kn: ಮುಂದಿನ ವರ್ಷ ಬೆಳಕು ಮತ್ತು ಬಣ್ಣಗಳಿಂದ ತುಂಬಿರಲಿ.
messages.ta: வரும் ஆண்டு ஒளியும் வண்ணமும் நிறைந்ததாக இருக்கட்டும்.

messages.en: Missing you this festival. I lit a diya for you.
messages.hi: इस त्योहार आपकी याद आ रही है। आपके लिए एक दीया जलाया है।
messages.kn: ಈ ಹಬ್ಬದಲ್ಲಿ ನಿಮ್ಮ ನೆನಪಾಗುತ್ತಿದೆ. ನಿಮಗಾಗಿ ಒಂದು ದೀಪ ಹಚ್ಚಿದ್ದೇನೆ.
messages.ta: இந்த பண்டிகையில் உங்கள் நினைவு வருகிறது. உங்களுக்காக ஒரு விளக்கு ஏற்றினேன்.

messages.hi: हर चीज़ के लिए शुक्रिया, हमेशा।

messages.en: Come home soon. The sweets are waiting.
messages.hi: जल्दी घर आओ। मिठाई इंतज़ार कर रही है।

messages.en: I lit a diya for you.
messages.hi: मैंने आपके लिए एक दीया जलाया है।
